description: Synthetic dialogue profile for the generated 18-frame two-character replay clip testdata/synthetic/replay/two-voices-001 (issue #36, gap row G3, ADR-0132; docs/spec/11 'Fixture origins'). The three real lines are the clip's invented sentences: two characters' lines and one unattributed (narrator) line; the rest are invented distractors so ranking a half-revealed line is a real decision (docs/spec/05 'Short strings and overlapping prefixes require more evidence'). No real game text. The speaker attribution and the per-character approved voices are deliberately NOT here: they live in the scenario (testdata/scenarios/synthetic/two-voices-001.yaml), because a profile has no speaker or voice column and the synthetic scenario declares both.

messages.original_text: The lighthouse keeper had not come down in three days.
His lamp still burns, though the town has stopped watching.
Somewhere past the breakwater a horn sounds twice.
The lighthouse keeper came down at first light.
His last letter spoke of the fog rolling in.
The town kept its own lamp lit for the boats.
Nobody lit the lamp after the keeper left.
The harbour bell answered the horn once at dusk.
The breakwater held against the winter sea.
A horn sounded once past the second point.
Lamplight burned low in the keeper's house.
The boats came in before the tide turned.
The water stayed grey all the way to the mole.
